claim: Each exact condition has two independent sessions.
All ROI are shown with equal session influence.
Raw and area-normalized sensitivity are compared for every ROI.
Session-level, not frame-level, spread is reported.
The complete 9x9 target/measured ROI matrix is retained.
Noise and drift use dedicated no-contact evidence.
Rate strata are shown rather than pooled.
The hold is labeled fixed-displacement relaxation, not creep.
The result is reported only as a stability proxy.
